title: Utility disturbance correlated with UPS and cooling alarms
root_cause_hypothesis: Normal utility instability caused ATS source loss indications and UPS battery support. Cooling temperature drift followed the power event while generator fuel level reduced standby confidence.
explanation: Correlation is based on a shared event window, EPMS source sequence, affected upstream power equipment, and downstream cooling drift. CRAC-2 is treated as a consequence to watch, not the initiating cause.
recommended_focus: Verify utility source stability first, then UPS autonomy, generator readiness, and cooling recovery
